title: RFID Windshield Tags
description: UHF RFID windshield tags for parking, tolling, fleet entry and vehicle identification programs that need fast hands-free reads through glass.
summary: RFID windshield tags are built for vehicle identification programs that need quick hands-free reads for parking, tolling and controlled-entry checkpoints.
ProudTek RFID windshield antenna is customize for optimal performance on glass,
Utilizing a paper substrate with an aluminum-etched antenna and a dummy kerf structure, ensuring comprehensive tamper resistance

faq.question: What are RFID Windshield Tags commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for parking, gated entry, tolling, and fleet programs that need windshield-mounted UHF vehicle credentials with fast drive-through reads.

faq.question: Which chip, protocol, or frequency options are available for RFID Windshield Tags?
faq.answer: Chip: UCODE 8/9, MONZA M4QT, UCODE DNA, H9, G2XM,etc. Frequency: 860-960MHZ, Read Range: 3 to 9m

faq.question: What material or form-factor options are available for RFID Windshield Tags?
faq.answer: Material: Substrate & Coating: paper,Antenna: Aluminum etched Dimensions: 86*54mm, 86*25mm (customizable)
